banner: TEMPLATE - NO REAL STT OUTPUT INCLUDED - REAL-WORLD INTENT ACCURACY: NOT MEASURED. Copy this file OUTSIDE the repository, replace every <placeholder>, remove the "template" flag and the TEMPLATE- prefix of corpus_id, then run: python -m evaluation.week8_intent_eval validate --manifest <file>
notes: Rules: every entry is a REAL_STT_REVIEWED transcript - the text the speech-to-text engine actually produced for a consented recording, checked by a person (reviewed_by_human must be true). Never type a transcript from memory or invent one. The text must be the command as recognised, with the wake phrase already removed (the output of speech/pipeline.py). consent_reference is a register id (CONSENT-<id> or APPROVAL-<id> with a digit), never a name; recording_ref is an opaque id of the Week 7 recording (never a file name or a person). split_or_purpose is DEV or HELDOUT; tune on DEV only. The expected_* fields are the gold labels written by a person who did NOT build the router, BEFORE the evaluation is run. A manifest with real entries must live OUTSIDE the repository, and so must its evidence. The evaluation stores ids and labels only, never the transcript.

entries.text: <the transcript exactly as produced by STT and confirmed by a person, e.g. turn on the lights>

real_stt.consent_reference: <CONSENT-<register id with a digit> - never a name>
real_stt.stt_engine_id: <engine id recorded by the Week 7 evidence, e.g. faster-whisper>
real_stt.recording_ref: <opaque id of the recording in the Week 7 corpus>

entries.expected_category: <one of the six official categories, or null for a rejection (INVALID_COMMAND: the recognised command category)>
